summary: Obfuscated preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes opaque bundle at install time
details: The package's declared `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) is itself obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (hex `_0x...` identifiers, per-function string dictionaries). On `npm install` it downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it 0755, and uses that freshly downloaded runtime via `execFileSync` to run a sibling file `math_init.js` — a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated bundle using custom string-array rotation. The package's stated purpose is a browser-side card-fields SDK; it ships no native addon and has no legitimate need for an alternate language runtime or install-time script execution. Executing under Bun bypasses any Node-based inspection of what actually runs on the installer's machine, and the payload is unauditable prior to execution. The obfuscation of both the lifecycle script and the executed payload, combined with the alternate-runtime execution vector, is characteristic of a supply-chain dropper rather than an SDK install step.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
